methods.model: Unchanged predict_effort.fit_training; fresh pipeline per repeat
methods.baseline: Constant mean of exactly the same training rows; no target imputation

preprocessing.normalization: Existing normalize_proposal; strip strings and normalize missing tokens
preprocessing.fit_scope: Training rows only; no tuning using race results

split_procedure.rounding: ceil(0.25 * number of distinct eligible groups)
split_procedure.index_convention: zero-based CSV data row excluding header
split_procedure.group_ids: first occurrence among eligible rows; normalized predictor tuple only

runtime_scope.model: fresh fit_training (including its unused mean computation) plus evaluation feature construction and prediction
runtime_scope.baseline: training target extraction, mean calculation, and constant prediction list
runtime_scope.excluded: imports, IO, validation, shared grouping/splitting and row selection, actual extraction, MAE and report serialization
runtime_scope.order: model then baseline; small timings are noisy and descriptive

tie_rule.definition: tie if abs(model MAE - baseline MAE) <= tolerance; win if lower otherwise loss

difference_definition: model MAE minus baseline MAE; negative favors model descriptively

statistical_analysis.reason: Project-required same comparison procedure not supplied among allowed inputs

limitations: Effort- physical units are unspecified; none are inferred.
An effort estimate alone does not justify approving a proposal.
Small historical observational dataset; one grouped split is not a guarantee of future accuracy.
No uncertainty intervals, approval guarantees, causal claims, or held-out tuning.
No proposal-time size estimate is supplied; delivered Kloc+ is excluded.
Predictor availability at proposal time is assumed and must be checked operationally.
Unseen categories encode as all zeros; missing categories use an explicit empty-string level.
Rows missing Effort- are excluded, never target-imputed; reported MAE is row-weighted.
Group split prevents identical normalized inputs crossing partitions, but related projects may remain.
Random forest predictions average training outcomes and may miss extreme or novel efforts.
Evaluation model remains fitted only to training rows; no full-dataset refit is performed.
Repeated partitions overlap within Trial 1; these are not independent LLM implementation trials.
Raw MAE differences and win/tie/loss counts do not establish statistical superiority.
Descriptive summaries weight seeds equally; each seed MAE weights evaluation rows equally.
MAE is not an individual proposal uncertainty interval; no automatic approval claims.
Timing is environment dependent and not reproducible bit for bit; partitions and predictions are reproducible in this environment.
